clips.title: The story
paras: Deep beneath the bustling city of Ironforge lies the Hall of Thanes, an ancient subterranean complex steeped in dwarven history. Intended for early Alliance adventurers, this secluded dungeon holds relics of the mountain kingdom's past that have fallen into peril. Gaining entry requires unearthing forgotten routes through the mountain itself.

While Ironforge hums with the ringing of hammers in the Great Forge, forgotten halls delve far deeper beneath the stone. The Hall of Thanes represents one of these venerable subterranean reaches. Long tied to ancestral dwarven bloodlines and relics of stonecraft, it now requires intrepid Alliance champions to venture into its shadowed vaults to secure the depths.
